title: AI 编码工具开始补设计课，也开始学会组队
opening: 今天值得看的不是又多了几个 Agent，而是围绕它们的“职业培训”突然成套出现了：有人教它们做不丑的页面，有人逼它们先想清楚再写代码，还有人给多代理协作配上独立工位。AI 编码的竞争，正在从“会不会写”移到“能不能稳定地把活做好”。

projects.summary: 把落地页设计规则装进 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 的技能包。
projects.problem: 目前的核心技能会先问需求，再处理页面结构、转化文案、字体、间距、圆角和动效。它还是一个刚起步的合集，但方向很实在：把设计师脑中的判断，整理成编码代理能执行的规则。

projects.name: Nutlope/hallmark
projects.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Hallmark **A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.** usehallmark.com  ·  fifty themes  ·  custom on request  ·  redesign and audit by name Made by Together AI. Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of every page, a form that says thanks without sending anything. A fresh-context reviewer gets the last word. The gates come in tiers. The **Floor** never ships (contrast, focus, reduced motion, invented facts, a broken phone layout). **Reflex** gates are the defaults a model falls into; a build with a reason may overrule one on the record. **Finish** checks are craft detail that never blocks a ship. New in v2 - **Fifty themes.** Each is a material (paper, type, colour, surfaces, its own components a
projects.summary: 不只教 AI 怎么设计，还让浏览器替它抓出页面里的“机器味”。
projects.problem: Hallmark 会从主题库里组合视觉方向，再检查对比度、焦点、动效，以及那些一眼就像 AI 模板的惯用套路，最后还安排独立上下文复审。它解决的不是“能不能生成页面”，而是“生成后敢不敢直接交付”。

projects.name: nightly-labs/openbot
projects.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
projects.readmeExcerpt: OpenBot OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. It supports the local Codex App Server and Claude Code, plus Grok CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor CLI, and Cline CLI through ACP. It gives every agent its own workspace and conversation, and provides local queues, file transfers, an embedded browser, and agent-to-agent messaging in one desktop app. > [!WARNING] > OpenBot is a development preview. Agents currently run with `danger-full-access` and > `approvalPolicy: never`. They can read and modify files, run commands, use the network, and control > the embedded browser without per-action confirmations after the explicit first-launch consent. > Run only agents and tasks you trust, keep backups, and review Security before use. What works - Prompt-driven agent creation and editing on desktop and mobile, with editable instructions, avatar, and section review before saving. - Persistent agents backed by independent Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, or Cline sessions and local workspaces. - Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and custom ACP agents, with detection of local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) and installed agents. - Per-agent context mo
projects.summary: 给多位 AI 代理分工位、排队列、传文件的本地桌面工作区。
projects.problem: Codex、Claude、Grok 等代理可以拥有各自的工作区和对话，同时共享任务、文件、浏览器与代理间消息。需要特别留意的是，它仍处于开发预览阶段，当前代理以高权限运行；能力很强，安全边界也必须自己看紧。

projects.name: obra/superpowers
projects.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Superpowers Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. Table of Contents - How it works - Commercial Services - Getting Started - Claude Code - Antigravity - Codex App - Codex CLI - Cursor - Devin CLI - Factory Droid - Gemini CLI - GitHub Copilot CLI - Grok Build CLI - Kimi Code - OpenCode - Pi - Qwen Code - Hermes Agent - Muse - The Basic Workflow - When Something Goes Wrong - Community - What's Inside - Philosophy - Contributing - Updating - License - Visual companion telemetry How it works It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aver
projects.summary: 一套会先逼编码代理想清需求，再允许它动手写代码的开发方法论。
projects.problem: 它用可组合的 skills 和启动指令约束代理流程，先澄清目标、形成规格，再进入实现。与其继续给模型堆提示词，它更像是在给 AI 工程师制定团队工作制度。

projects.name: pbakaus/impeccable
projects.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Impeccable The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships. From your project root: Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at impeccable.style/docs. | Without Impeccable | With Impeccable | Same model (Fable 5.1), same brief: a fourteen-room family guesthouse on the Ligurian coast. Without Impeccable, it builds the tasteful default: cream page, thin serif, italic accent, pill buttons. With it, the page is built around one picture: the house at night, seen from the water. For a full project, see the Neo Mirai case study: a conference site taken from mockup to shipped page. Why Inter for everything. Purple-to-blue gradients. projects.summary: 用 polish、bolder、critique 和 audit 给编码代理补一套设计词汇。
projects.problem: 它不换模型，而是改变代理观察和评价界面的方式：需要更大胆时怎么说，交付前如何批评和审计，怎样识别模板化的 AI 设计。适合已经能生成页面，却总觉得成品“哪儿都对、就是没味道”的场景。

projects.name: JetBrains/thinkrail
projects.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
projects.readmeExcerpt: ThinkRail ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it — learning your project through living specs today, and building its own capabilities tomorrow. We built a rich interface around the `pi` coding agent, isolated work into separate workspaces, and gave the agent durable project knowledge through living specs and reusable skills. Next, we're adding full extension support, so ThinkRail can create the tools it needs based on how you actually work. **Website:** thinkrail.ai · **Blog:** thinkrail.ai/blog · **Discord:** thinkrail.ai/discord ⭐ If you find ThinkRail useful, give it a star — it helps others discover it. *A `pi` session and the change it made, scoped to an isolated git-worktree workspace.* What you get - **Isolated workspaces.** Open any git repo as a project and cut workspaces from it as `git worktree`s, each with its own branch and working directory. Agents work in parallel without touching your checkout; merge the good branch, delete the rest. You can also attach existing worktrees or explicitly work in the project folder itself. Finished and dormant workspaces settle onto a per-project shelf on their own — when their pull request merges or close
projects.summary: 用独立 worktree 隔开任务，再用 living specs 给 Agent 留项目记忆的 IDE。
projects.problem: ThinkRail 围绕 pi 编码代理做了一层完整界面，每项任务可以进入独立分支和工作目录，项目知识则沉淀成持续更新的规格与技能。它最有意思的地方，是把“边聊边写”往可追踪、可复用的工程流程推了一步。

closing: 今天最值得记住的，不是某个 Agent 又多会了一招，而是大家开始认真给它们补流程、审美、记忆和边界。模型像员工，skills 与工作区正在变成真正决定产出的管理制度；OpenBot 这类高权限预览版也提醒我们，能力越强，护栏越不能省。
